services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Join us for guided ice fishing trips from late November to mid-April, depending on ice conditions. Dillon Reservoir is known for its plentiful Arctic Char, Kokanee Salmon, Brown Trout, and Rainbow Trout while Green Mountain Reservoir boasts larger Kokanee Salmon, big Lake Trout and Northern Pike! We provide everything you need for a fantastic ice fishing experience, including heated huts, tackle, bait, seating and ice fishing sonars. Dress warmly, like you’re going skiing! Please bring your own food and drinks. We invite participants of all ages, abilities, and fishing skills! quotes.author: Sandra Moua
quotes.text: While on vacation, my husband and I decided to try something new in addition to skiing, and that is ice fishing. We’re so glad we did! The experience exceeded our expectations. Our guide, Ken, was incredibly knowledgeable and made the whole outing enjoyable and easy to follow. We had a fantastic time catching trout, and the breathtaking mountain views in the background made it even more special. It was truly a memorable experience that we would highly recommend!

quotes.author: Allison Armstrong
quotes.text: An awesome experience! Judson exceed our expectations and we had the best time ice fish. This was our first time ice fishing and Judson was an excellent guide teaching us all we need to know. Our group caught 10 fish!! We had so much fun my youngest (10 year old) was so excited and caught 3 fish. I caught a beautiful Char. Definitely recommend you will not regret!

quotes.author: Craig Hewitt
quotes.text: We had Judson as our guide. We can’t recommend him enough. From the get go he was welcoming and informative and that led to us having a great fishing experience. Catching a bunch of fish and being able to relax while Judson put in all the hard work to make sure every single one of us caught a fish. 5 stars all day long. Can’t recommend the whole company enough

quotes.author: josh bradley
quotes.text: First time ice fishing was a little nervous walking on the ice didn’t want to fall thru lol safe as can be. Ken was awesome took me to some spots that he knew hav fish and didn’t disappoint. Picked a few salmon and trout with a 21” Char (put the Char back in the water) definitely will be back maybe I can get Ken to take me out for some Elk 😁

quotes.author: Amanda Minks
quotes.text: We had an amazing day! Our guide Jason was great. Having a 10 year old boy who never fly fished before, I was a little nervous on how the day would go. Jason was so patient and a great teacher. After an hour or so the kids started to get the hang of it and we all had so much fun. The highlight of our trip for sure!

quotes.author: Bobbi Moser
quotes.text: We went fly fishing today and our guide Jason was great. He is very knowledgeable and was a great teacher. He was very patient and my grandson and I were able to catch quite a few fish. This was our first time fly fishing and Jason made it a great experience.
